strongest_angle: The World Meteorological Organization documented extreme global temperatures, melting ice, and rising sea levels in Antalya, Türkiye in November 2026, driven by an intensifying El Niño event.

key_facts.fact: The World Meteorological Organization published a report in Antalya, Türkiye in November 2026 detailing extreme global temperatures, melting ice, and rising sea levels.
The global average surface temperature for January to September 2026 was 1.47 degrees Celsius above the pre-industrial average according to the World Meteorological Organization.
key_facts.source_name: Red Cross Red Crescent Climate Centre

key_facts.fact: Ocean heat content in the upper 2000 meters of the ocean in 2025 exceeded the 2024 value by 19 zettajoules.
